prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1262; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane and reported that Driver 2 struck the side of the vehicle while Driver 1 was completing a left turn at the intersection in Katy, Texas. Driver 1 stated that the impact pushed the vehicle forward and that a shoulder injury was sustained during the collision. Driver 2 was present at the scene and was cooperative throughout the investigation. The damage visible on Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the direction and force of the impact described by both parties. Scene photographs taken at the location confirm several of the reported details, although no independent witnesses came forward to provide a statement. The responding officers and the parties at the scene confirm that a Passenger was also inside Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision. Inspection did not reveal any prior damage to the vehicle, and no earlier repairs were identified. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy involved. The reported injury appears consistent with the nature and force of the impact. No citations were issued at the scene, and the matter has been documented for further review.
